segments.name: blank check company
segments.description: A blank check company formed to pursue a business combination with one or more target businesses; it has no operating revenues.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated on June 7, 2024 in the Cayman Islands as an exempted company, for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities (a "Business Combination").

revenueModel.text: The company has generated no revenues and is funded by investors who buy its Units and by its Sponsor and EBC through private placement purchases, not by customers.
revenueModel.evidence: We have generated no revenues to date and we do not expect that we will generate operating revenues until, at the earliest, we consummate our initial Business Combination.
